description: This PHP source file defines the class AORReportsDashlet, which is a custom dashlet for displaying AOR reports within the SugarCRM framework. It includes methods for constructing the dashlet, rendering its display, generating HTML for charts, customizing options, and saving configurations. The class interacts with report beans, templates, and external utilities related to the AOR_Reports module.

classes.name: AORReportsDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class extending SugarCRM's Dashlet to display AOR reports with configurable options and chart rendering features.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with configuration, report bean, and parameters.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet view with report chart and parameters.

methods.name: getChartHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for the report chart based on the report bean.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays the configuration options for the dashlet.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves the user-selected configuration options for the dashlet.

methods.name: hasAccess
methods.description: Returns whether the user has access to this dashlet (always true here).
